provenance.harness: headless command lane, purpose-built driver + map-aware dump (task 1069)
provenance.notes: 60 cells at ~2.7 s each, no display and no GUI. TWO map kinds were found where the audit assumed one: a RELATIVE kind storing deltas (created empty) and an ABSOLUTE kind storing positions (created dense). The delta-vs-absolute question was decided by editing the base AFTER the map -- and by a SCALE as well as a translate, since a translate alone cannot separate the candidates. The viewport question (does it draw base+delta while a map is selected) had no headless proxy here and was settled separately by a GUI capture; see the task's Phase 0.

_about: Reference-editor morph-map behaviour, captured through a headless command lane (one fresh engine per case). Keyed on GEOMETRY (vertex positions), never on index. SCRUBBED for neutrality (task 1069): every number is verbatim from the capture; the reference's command ids and its two four-character map-type tags were replaced with neutral prose and with the kind names 'relative' / 'absolute'. Seven case keys and seven cell ids carried a tag fragment and were renamed with it: bgmorph_is_dense -> background_to_morph_is_dense, lxo_roundtrip -> reference_native_roundtrip, morf_empty_at_creation -> relative_empty_at_creation, spot_apply_half_keeps_target -> absolute_apply_half_keeps_target, spot_base_translate_keeps_target -> absolute_base_translate_keeps_target, spot_dense_at_creation -> absolute_dense_at_creation, spot_stores_absolute -> absolute_stores_position

_base_mesh.note: axis-aligned box, deliberately asymmetric and origin-free so 'delta' and 'absolute' can never coincide

edit_routes_into_selected_morph._desc: relative map M selected; the unified transform's move of (0.25,-0.1,0.05) applied to the vertex at (0.8,1.2,1.6)

edit_moves_base_when_no_morph_selected._desc: no map selected; the same move -> the BASE moves and no map is written

base_translate_leaves_delta._desc: map holds a delta; map deselected; the base vertex translated by (0.4,0.3,-0.2) -> the stored delta is unchanged

base_scale_leaves_delta._desc: map deselected; the whole box scaled x2 about the origin -> the stored delta is STILL unchanged. The decisive case: a translate alone cannot separate 'store a delta' from 'store a position and re-derive it', a x2 scale can -- storing in the transformed frame would predict 2*D, re-deriving from a stored position would predict (stored position - new base)

absolute_stores_position._desc: an ABSOLUTE map selected; the same move -> the map stores absolute POSITIONS and is dense

zero_delta_entry_survives._desc: move by D then by -D with the map selected -> the entry REMAINS, with value 0. A returned-to-zero entry is not erased

zero_move_creates_entries._desc: all 8 vertices selected, moved by (0,0,0) -> 8 entries, every one zero. Entries follow the SELECTION, not the displacement

entries_follow_the_selection._desc: 4 vertices selected and moved -> exactly 4 entries

absolute_dense_at_creation._desc: create an ABSOLUTE map -> 8 entries, a snapshot of every base position

relative_empty_at_creation._desc: create a RELATIVE map -> 0 entries; the map exists and holds no values

clear_is_selection_scoped._desc: a dense map, 4 vertices selected, clear -> exactly those 4 entries are gone; the rest survive

subdivide_interpolates_the_map._desc: subdivide the faces; new vertices get the position-interpolated delta, with absent parents counted as zero

bevel_duplicates_the_entry._desc: bevel with inset 0.1; the inset copy of a corner inherits the source corner's delta verbatim

reference_native_roundtrip._desc: save and reopen in the reference's OWN native format -> the map, its sparsity and its values are preserved. NOT a claim about our formats: our .v3d and .lwo round trips are self-consistency tests seeded with these values

apply_full._desc: apply the map at strength 1.0 (a smoke case: every candidate law agrees here)

apply_x100._desc: apply at strength 100.0 -- no clamp; float32 rounding is visible in the result and sets the tolerance rule

deformer_two_morphs_add._desc: two maps M=(0.25,-0.1,0.05) and N=(0,0,0.4) applied through the deformer mechanism, both at strength 1.0, then baked -> the deltas ADD rather than one overriding the other

deformer_strength_half._desc: one map through the deformer mechanism at strength 0.5 -- the cross-check that the deformer and the direct apply agree

deformer_strength_0._desc: deformer strength 0.0 (a smoke case: every candidate law agrees here)

absolute_apply_half_keeps_target._desc: an ABSOLUTE map deselected, applied at 0.5 -> the base moves halfway to the stored target AND the stored target is NOT re-snapshotted

absolute_base_translate_keeps_target._desc: an ABSOLUTE map deselected; the base vertex translated -> the stored absolute target is unchanged

delta_is_item_local._desc: the mesh item rotated +90 degrees about Y; the tool moves world +X by 0.25 -> the stored delta is (0,0,0.25), i.e. the ITEM-LOCAL displacement

delta_is_item_local_control._desc: the same rotation with no map selected: the base vertex moves to local (0.8,1.2,1.85) -- the control showing the tool's axis is world

edits_accumulate._desc: two successive gestures with one map selected -> the stored delta is their SUM, not the last one

background_to_morph_is_dense._desc: the dedicated background-mesh-into-a-map command, relative kind -> an entry for EVERY vertex, value = background position - foreground position

new_map_steals_the_selection._desc: create a second map while M is selected -> the next edit lands in the NEW map

topology_edit_still_hits_the_base._desc: a map is SELECTED; subdivide -> the base topology changes anyway. Topology operations are NOT routed

freeze_deform_keeps_the_map._desc: baking the deformed positions into the base LEAVES the stored map value untouched

golden_three_entries._desc: a box plus one relative map with three distinct entries

golden_apply_05._desc: the same, then applied at strength 0.5

golden_subdivide._desc: the same, then subdivided with the map deselected

golden_deformer_025._desc: the same, through the deformer mechanism at strength 0.25, then baked
